steps.description: Angular 13: ViewEngine removed, IE11 dropped, APF v13, persistentTsConfig

breakingChanges.description: ViewEngine is fully removed — all code must compile with Ivy
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: ViewEngine is fully removed — all code must compile with Ivy

breakingChanges.description: IE11 is no longer supported; remove IE-specific polyfills
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: IE11 is no longer supported; remove IE-specific polyfills

breakingChanges.description: TestBed.get() is removed. Use TestBed.inject() instead
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: const svc = TestBed.inject(MyService);

breakingChanges.description: ModuleWithProviders must have an explicit generic type parameter
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: static forRoot(): ModuleWithProviders<MyModule>

breakingChanges.description: Date pipe now requires valid ISO 8601 date strings
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: Date pipe now requires valid ISO 8601 date strings

manualActions: Remove IE11 polyfills (classlist, web-animations-js) from polyfills.ts
Add generic type to all ModuleWithProviders usages

steps.description: Angular 14: Standalone components (developer preview), typed reactive forms, inject() function

breakingChanges.description: Reactive forms are now strictly typed; untyped variants have Untyped prefix
breakingChanges.after: new FormControl<string | null>(null)  // or new UntypedFormControl()
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: new FormControl<string | null>(null)  // or new UntypedFormControl()

breakingChanges.description: RouterLinkWithHref merged into RouterLink directive
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: RouterLinkWithHref merged into RouterLink directive

manualActions: Migrate FormControl usages to typed forms or prefix with Untyped
Remove RouterLinkWithHref imports — use RouterLink instead

steps.description: Angular 15: Stable standalone APIs, directive composition API, ESM-only packages

breakingChanges.description: Router option 'enabled' renamed to 'enabledBlocking'
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: initialNavigation: 'enabledBlocking'

breakingChanges.description: DATE_PIPE_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE token replaced by DATE_PIPE_DEFAULT_OPTIONS
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: DATE_PIPE_DEFAULT_TIMEZONE token replaced by DATE_PIPE_DEFAULT_OPTIONS

breakingChanges.description: Angular packages are now ESM-only; CommonJS projects need build tooling adjustment
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: Angular packages are now ESM-only; CommonJS projects need build tooling adjustment

manualActions: Run: ng update @angular/cdk@15 @angular/material@15 (if used) — note: Angular Material 15 is the MDC migration; expect component API changes
Replace 'enabled' with 'enabledBlocking' in router initialNavigation option

steps.description: Angular 16: Signals (developer preview), required inputs, inject() in guards/resolvers

breakingChanges.description: Class-based guards are deprecated; migrate to functional guards
breakingChanges.before:
@Injectable()
export class AuthGuard implements CanActivate { canActivate() {} }
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: export const authGuard: CanActivateFn = () => inject(AuthService).isLoggedIn();

breakingChanges.description: ngcc (Angular Compatibility Compiler) is removed
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: ngcc (Angular Compatibility Compiler) is removed

breakingChanges.description: Standalone bootstrap APIs can replace HttpClientModule with provideHttpClient(), but NgModule bootstraps may need a guided migration
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: If the app uses bootstrapApplication(), move HttpClient setup to providers with provideHttpClient(); keep HttpClientModule for NgModule-only bootstraps until the module architecture is migrated.

manualActions: Migrate class-based guards to functional guards
Remove ngcc postinstall script from package.json if present

steps.description: Angular 17: Built-in control flow (@if, @for, @switch), deferrable views (@defer), new project defaults

breakingChanges.description: New built-in @if replaces *ngIf (old syntax still works but is legacy)
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance:
@if (condition) {
...
}

breakingChanges.description: New built-in @for replaces *ngFor; requires track expression
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance:
@for (item of items; track item.id) {
  • {{ item }}
    • }

breakingChanges.description: New built-in @switch replaces *ngSwitch
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: @switch (value) { @case ('a') { A } }

breakingChanges.description: BrowserModule.withServerTransition is deprecated
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: BrowserModule.withServerTransition is deprecated

manualActions: Optionally run the control-flow migration: ng g @angular/core:control-flow
Add track expression to all @for blocks

steps.description: Angular 18: Stable control flow, experimental zoneless, material 3 stable

breakingChanges.description: Experimental zoneless change detection is available via provideExperimentalZonelessChangeDetection()
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: Experimental zoneless change detection is available via provideExperimentalZonelessChangeDetection()

breakingChanges.description: Router guards can now return RedirectCommand for typed redirects
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: Router guards can now return RedirectCommand for typed redirects

conditionalNpmInstall.condition: @angular/material detected — Angular Material 18 includes stable Material 3 theme support

steps.description: Angular 19: Stable signal APIs, incremental hydration (developer preview), route-level render mode, @let template variables

breakingChanges.description: afterRender hook phase constants renamed: EarlyRead → Read, Write → Write, MixedReadWrite → MixedReadWrite (verify with ng update schematic)
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: afterRender hook phase constants renamed: EarlyRead → Read, Write → Write, MixedReadWrite → MixedReadWrite (verify with ng update schematic)

breakingChanges.description: withFetch() is now the default for Angular 19 new projects; existing projects are unaffected unless explicitly relying on XHR behavior differences
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: withFetch() is now the default for Angular 19 new projects; existing projects are unaffected unless explicitly relying on XHR behavior differences

breakingChanges.description: New components generated by the CLI are standalone by default; existing NgModule-based components are unchanged
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: New components generated by the CLI are standalone by default; existing NgModule-based components are unchanged

manualActions: Review afterRender() usages if using phase-specific hooks
Verify HttpClient behavior if your app relies on XHR-specific features (cookies, withCredentials)

steps.description: Angular 20: Stable incremental hydration, stable resource API, signal-based forms (developer preview)

breakingChanges.description: ReflectiveInjector was deprecated since Angular 8 and is fully removed in v20. Use Injector.create() instead.
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: Injector.create({ providers: [{ provide: MyService }] })

breakingChanges.description: Several deprecated TestBed APIs from v12–v15 emit hard errors in v20 where they previously warned
breakingChanges.remediationGuidance: Several deprecated TestBed APIs from v12–v15 emit hard errors in v20 where they previously warned

manualActions: Search for ReflectiveInjector and migrate to Injector.create()
Run ng build and ng test after upgrade; address any newly-hard errors from deprecated APIs

steps.description: Angular 21: framework, CLI, Material/CDK, TypeScript and ecosystem compatibility upgrade
manualActions: Review the Angular 21 update guide for any breaking changes specific to your setup
Run ng build and ng test after upgrade

plan.effortBasis: 24 catalogued breaking changes, 35 manual actions across 9 hop(s) — does not account for test coverage or CI complexity
